segs.pali: (27) 7. Kammapathavaggo
1. Pāṇātipātīsuttaṃ
segs.zh: 1. [[pāṇātipātīsutta|杀生者经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Catūhi , bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. Katamehi catūhi? Attanā ca pāṇātipātī hoti, parañca pāṇātipāte samādapeti, pāṇātipāte ca samanuñño hoti, pāṇātipātassa ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足四法者，犹如被带来投入地狱一般。哪四种？自己行杀生，又劝导他人杀生，于杀生随喜，并赞叹杀生——诸比丘，具足此四法者，犹如被带来投入地狱一般。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge. Katamehi catūhi? Attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, parañca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti, pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge’’ti. Paṭhamaṃ.
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足四法者，犹如被运来安置于天界一般。哪四种？自己远离杀生，也劝导他人远离杀生，于远离杀生随喜，并赞叹远离杀生——诸比丘，具足此四法者，犹如被运来安置于天界一般。”第一。

segs.pali: 2. Adinnādāyīsuttaṃ
segs.zh: 2. [[adinnādāyīsutta|不与取者经]]

segs.pali: ‘‘Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. Katamehi catūhi? Attanā ca adinnādāyī hoti, parañca adinnādāne samādapeti, adinnādāne ca samanuñño hoti, adinnādānassa ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho…pe….
segs.zh: “诸比丘，具足四法者，犹如被带来弃掷于地狱之中。哪四种？自己不与取，劝他人不与取，赞同不与取，赞叹不与取——具足这四种法者，即如被带来弃掷于地狱之中。”

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, parañca adinnādānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, adinnādānā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti, adinnādānā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho, bhikkhave…pe…. Dutiyaṃ.
segs.zh: “自己远离不与取，亦劝导他人远离不与取，赞同远离不与取，赞叹远离不与取——诸比丘，具足这些法者……” 第二。

segs.pali: 3. Micchācārīsuttaṃ
segs.zh: 3. [[micchācārīsutta|邪行者经]]

segs.pali: … Attanā ca kāmesumicchācārī hoti, parañca kāmesumicchācāre samādapeti, kāmesumicchācāre ca samanuñño hoti, kāmesumicchācārassa ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho…pe….
segs.zh: 自己行欲邪行，劝他人行欲邪行，赞同欲邪行，赞叹欲邪行——以此……

segs.pali: Attanā ca kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, parañca kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho…pe…. Tatiyaṃ.
segs.zh: 自己远离欲邪行，亦劝导他人远离欲邪行，赞同远离欲邪行，赞叹远离欲邪行——以这些……第三。

segs.pali: 4. Musāvādīsuttaṃ
segs.zh: 4. [[musāvādīsutta|妄语者经]]

segs.pali: … Attanā ca musāvādī hoti, parañca musāvāde samādapeti, musāvāde ca samanuñño hoti, musāvādassa ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho…pe….
segs.zh: 他不仅自己妄语，还教他人妄语，赞同妄语，并称赞妄语——以此……

segs.pali: Attanā ca musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, parañca musāvādā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, musāvādā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti, musāvādā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi…pe…. Catutthaṃ.
segs.zh: 他自己远离妄语，也劝他人远离妄语，赞同远离妄语，并称赞远离妄语——以此……第四。

segs.pali: 5. Pisuṇavācāsuttaṃ
segs.zh: 5. [[pisuṇavācāsutta|两舌经]]

segs.pali: … Attanā ca pisuṇavāco hoti, parañca pisuṇāya vācāya samādapeti, pisuṇāya vācāya ca samanuñño hoti, pisuṇāya vācāya ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi…pe….
segs.zh: 自己两舌，也劝导他人两舌，随喜两舌，赞叹两舌……

segs.pali: Attanā ca pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, parañca pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇiyā samādapeti, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi…pe…. Pañcamaṃ.
segs.zh: 自己远离两舌，亦劝导他人远离两舌，赞同远离两舌，赞叹远离两舌。第五。

segs.pali: 6. Pharusavācāsuttaṃ
segs.zh: 6. [[pharusavācāsutta|粗恶语经]]

segs.pali: … Attanā ca pharusavāco hoti, parañca pharusāya vācāya samādapeti, pharusāya vācāya ca samanuñño hoti, pharusāya vācāya ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati…pe….
segs.zh: ……他自己说粗恶语，也劝导他人说粗恶语，随喜粗恶语，赞叹粗恶语……

segs.pali: Attanā ca pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, parañca pharusāya vācāya veramaṇiyā samādapeti, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho…pe…. Chaṭṭhaṃ.
segs.zh: 他自己远离粗恶语，也劝导他人远离粗恶语，随喜远离粗恶语，赞叹远离粗恶语——以这些……第六。

segs.pali: 7. Samphappalāpasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 7. [[samphappalāpasutta|杂秽语经]]

segs.pali: … Attanā ca samphappalāpī hoti, parañca samphappalāpe samādapeti, samphappalāpe ca samanuñño hoti, samphappalāpassa ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi…pe….
segs.zh: 自己说绮语，也劝导他人说绮语，随喜说绮语，称扬赞叹绮语——以此……

segs.pali: Attanā ca samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, parañca samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti, samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho, bhikkhave…pe…. Sattamaṃ.
segs.zh: 自己远离绮语，也劝导他人远离绮语，赞同远离绮语，称扬赞叹远离绮语——诸比丘，以此……第七。

segs.pali: 8. Abhijjhālusuttaṃ
segs.zh: 8. [[abhijjhālusutta|贪欲者经]]

segs.pali: … Attanā ca abhijjhālu hoti, parañca abhijjhāya samādapeti, abhijjhāya ca samanuñño hoti, abhijjhāya ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati…pe….
segs.zh: 自己心怀贪婪，也教人贪婪，随喜贪婪，赞叹贪婪……

segs.pali: ‘‘Attanā ca anabhijjhālu hoti, parañca anabhijjhāya samādapeti, anabhijjhāya ca samanuñño hoti, anabhijjhāya ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho…pe…. Aṭṭhamaṃ.
segs.zh: “自己心离贪婪，也教人不贪婪，随喜不贪婪，赞叹不贪婪——以这些……”第八。

segs.pali: 9. Byāpannacittasuttaṃ
segs.zh: 9. [[byāpannacittasutta|心嗔害者经]]

segs.pali: … Attanā ca byāpannacitto hoti, parañca byāpāde samādapeti, byāpāde ca samanuñño hoti, byāpādassa ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi…pe….
segs.zh: 自己心怀瞋恨，也劝导他人瞋恨，赞同瞋恨，又赞叹瞋恨——以这些……

segs.pali: Attanā ca abyāpannacitto hoti, parañca abyāpāde samādapeti, abyāpāde ca samanuñño hoti, abyāpādassa ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho…pe…. Navamaṃ.
segs.zh: 自己心无瞋恨，也劝导他人无瞋恨，赞同无瞋恨，又赞叹无瞋恨——以这些……第九。

segs.pali: 10. Micchādiṭṭhisuttaṃ
segs.zh: 10. [[micchādiṭṭhisutta|邪见经]]

segs.pali: … Attanā ca micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañca micchādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti, micchādiṭṭhiyā ca samanuñño hoti, micchādiṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi…pe….
segs.zh: 自己执持邪见，也劝导他人执持邪见，赞同邪见，又称赞邪见——以这些……

segs.pali: Attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti, sammādiṭṭhiyā ca samanuñño hoti, sammādiṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati – imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ saggeti. Dasamaṃ.
segs.zh: 自身具足正见，又能劝导他人确立正见，随喜正见，并赞叹正见——诸比丘，具足此四法者，犹如被携来而安置于天界。第十。

segs.pali: Kammapathavaggo sattamo.
segs.zh: 第七 业道品
